text:
lina-csm: Noticed several intake leads tagged for SI but no owner. Need simple routing rules + auto-release. Quick thoughts?

 tom-sales: Proposal: 1) Marketplace-sourced -> partner-owned 2) SI-intro warm -> AE+SI co-assign 3) ACV >= 150k -> AE-owned (SI as delivery). Add HubSpot fields: si_flag, claim_owner.

 anna-partnerops: I can build the workflow to set fields and post to a webhook. Who owns endpoint infra?

 deploy-bot: deploy-bot: eng-platform owns the webhook infra. Created INF-999 to add /si/claims and doc payload.

 kevin-si: SI asks explicit consent on intake (si_consent=yes) before we surface contact info. Also request auto-release after 6 days of no partner activity.

 pete-legal: Legal needs consent checkbox text and to confirm payload excludes PII. Partners must have CDA before receiving contact emails.

 anna-partnerops: I'll own workflow + auto-release, and draft adjudication checklist for multi-claim conflicts. Target: first pass by Fri EOD.

 tom-sales: I'll set a 20m sync tomorrow to finalize. Agenda: HubSpot fields, webhook spec, adjudication steps, auto-release timer.

 lina-csm: Thanks — I'll update intake copy and collate into a playbook page once the checklist lands. :raised_hands:
